master_headline: MAN UTD TARGET CALVIN BASSEY AS FULHAM OPEN CONTRACT TALKS
ticker_text: TRANSFER DESK: Manchester United PREPARE £30M PROPOSAL ✦ Fulham: Marco Silva RESISTS EXIT ✦

scenes.spoken_narration: Fulham are reluctant, but United are circling a defensive star.
And — United reports say Calvin Bassey is priced at thirty million pounds, plus performance add‑ons.
Now — Manchester United propose a thirty‑million fee, with a five‑year contract clause.
Meanwhile — Fulham manager Marco Silva urges board to lock Bassey’s extension.

on_screen.headline: Silva pushes extension
on_screen.subheadline: Board urged to seal new deal

scenes.spoken_narration: So — will United secure the defender, or will Fulham keep him?
Either way — this is football in thirty seconds. Follow for daily transfer updates.
